title: Parkinson's Disease Freezing of Gait (FoG) Symptom Detection Using Machine Learning from Wearable Sensor Data
abstract: arXiv:2506.12561v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Freezing of gait (FoG) is a special symptom found in patients with Parkinson's disease (PD). Patients who have FoG abruptly lose the capacity to walk as they normally would. Accelerometers worn by patients can record movement data during these episodes, and machine learning algorithms can be useful to categorize this information. Thus, the combination may be able to identify FoG in real time. In order to identify FoG events in accelerometer data, we introduce the Transformer Encoder-Bi-LSTM fusion model in this paper. The model's capability to differentiate between FoG episodes and normal movement was used to evaluate its performance, and on the Kaggle Parkinson's Freezing of Gait dataset, the proposed Transformer Encoder-Bi-LSTM fusion model produced 92.6% accuracy, 80.9% F1 score, and 52.06% in terms of mean average precision. translated_title: 基于机器学习和可穿戴传感器数据的帕金森病冻结步态（FoG）症状检测
translated_abstract: 冻结步态（FoG）是帕金森病（PD）患者中出现的一种特殊症状，患有FoG的患者会突然失去正常行走的能力。患者佩戴的加速度计可以记录这些发作期间的运动数据，而机器学习算法可以有效地对这些信息进行分类，因此这种结合可能能够实时识别FoG。为了在加速度计数据中识别FoG事件，本文提出了Transformer编码器-Bi-LSTM融合模型。该模型的性能通过其区分FoG发作和正常运动的能力进行评估，在Kaggle帕金森病冻结步态数据集上，所提出的Transformer编码器-Bi-LSTM融合模型达到了92.6%的准确率、80.9%的F1分数以及52.06%的平均精度均值。研究结果突显了基于深度学习的方法在推动FoG识别领域发展方面的潜力。
tldr: 本文提出Transformer编码器-Bi-LSTM融合模型，利用可穿戴加速度计数据实时检测帕金森病患者的冻结步态症状，在Kaggle数据集上取得了92.6%的准确率和80.9%的F1分数。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a Transformer Encoder-Bi-LSTM fusion model for real-time detection of Parkinson's disease freezing of gait (FoG) from wearable accelerometer data, achieving 92.6% accuracy and 80.9% F1 score on the Kaggle Parkinson's Freezing of Gait dataset.
